[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1vt[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Resilient epic launches under concurrent bead-ID minting[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Approved epics launch successfully even when another machine or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent mints and publishes beads in the same store at the same time.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ID collisions are relocated automatically, removed IDs are never [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]minted again, a launch never reuses another plan's epic, and a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]graph that cannot be merged is re-minted from the plan instead of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]wedging the workspace store.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/resilient_epic_launch.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-1vt[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-1vt/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Published-ID collision rule in the sase-core stream merge[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]merge[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]merge: replace the raw issue_created count in the Rust three-way stream [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]merge with a rule that relocates any unpublished creation of a published[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ID and accepts create/remove/create history, plus a Python resolver [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]regression for the incident's stream shape.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Advance next_counter past every relocation and stream ID[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]counter[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]counter: make the bead conflict resolver write config.json next_counter [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]past every relocation ID and every stream ID in the store, even when [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]config.json itself merged cleanly, so a rollback-and-retry never [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-mints a relocated ID.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pre-mint store refresh and linked-epic identity check[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]premint[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]premint: integrate the remote bead store right before each epic-creation[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]attempt (fail open on transient errors, fail early on conflicts), record[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the launch base commit, and treat a plan bead_id link whose epic belongs[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to a different plan as stale.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Conflict replay for unmergeable zero-spawn graph publication[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]replay[dim] · [dim][/dim]after premint[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]replay: carry the integration status out of the managed sync worker, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]raise a typed publication-conflict error, and in the plan-launch retry [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]loop discard the launch's own unpublished graph commit under a recovery [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ref and re-mint, with cause-first error text.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Incident regression suite and docs[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]regress[dim] · [dim][/dim]after merge, counter, premint, replay[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]regress: reproduce the full three-clone collision chain end to end with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]real git clones, assert the launch succeeds under fresh IDs, and update [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the bead-storage and epic-launch reference docs.[/#D7D7AF]
